author: bardic-inspiration
name: Crypt Zealot
summary: A shaven fanatic in grave-wrappings who swings a bone-studded mace and grows bolder as blood is spilled.
description: Zealots are the cult's answer to every locked door. They fast before a raid, scar their palms with the god's wheel, and are baffled when anyone hesitates to die for the cause.

traits.name: Fervor of the Grave
traits.text: While the zealot is Bloodied, its weapon attacks deal an extra {dmg:1d6:necrotic}.

actions.name: Bone Mace
actions.onHit: If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {ref:condition/prone} condition.
